name: Pease Bay Holiday Park
accommodation: Holiday caravans and lodges, including the Signature Driftwood Lodge
suitableFor: Families and groups wanting a park on the beach
dogs: Dog-friendly area in the Smugglers Bar
beachAccess: On the beachfront, a short walk to the sand
confirmedFeatures: Bar and restaurant with takeaway, shop, arcade, play park, family entertainment room
overview: Pease Bay Holiday Park sits right on the beachfront at Cockburnspath, with the sand a short walk from the caravans and lodges. It is open all year and has the Smugglers Bar and Restaurant, a shop, an arcade and a play park. The operator describes it as great for surfing and sea kayaking.
surfTripFit: You stay right above the break, so you can check conditions without driving.
